name: transformer encoder block, 768-dim, 512 tokens
_comment: Feed to model_arithmetic.py --spec. Shapes are per example, no batch dim. The two feedforward linears run position-wise over the (512, 768) sequence: one weight matrix shared across all 512 tokens, which is what a transformer FFN actually is. Do NOT insert a flatten before them — that models a dense layer over the whole flattened sequence and inflates the parameter count by 512x. Note how the mha row's cost grows quadratically with sequence length: double 512 to 1024 and the attention term quadruples while the projections only double.
